follow_on.explanation: Ireland v Pakistan 2018 (1127284) enforced with a lead of 180: day 1 was washed out, so Law 14.1.3 applied the four-day threshold of 150. The timeline does not model lost days; time_rain/tactics should.

replacements.explanation: A single supersub-coded replacement in WBBL 2020/21; WBBL did not use the BBL X-factor rule, so it is treated as a non-tactical replacement.
